important_dates.examination date: To be notified on the official website

age_limit.details: No person shall be recruited to the service by direct appointment, if he/she is less than 18 years or is more than 42 years of age as on 01.07.2026.

qualification.details: A candidate should fulfil the conditions of qualification as on 01.07.2026.

salary_details.pay_scale: Consolidated pay of Rs. 25,500/- (initial pay in FPL-4)
salary_details.stenographer grade iii: Consolidated pay of Rs.25,500/- (i.e. initial pay in FPL-4) or at such revised rate as may be prescribed by the Government of Haryana from time to time.

selection_process: Shorthand Test English Shorthand and Transcription Pass a test at a speed of 80 W.P.M. in English Shorthand and 20 W.P.M. in transcription of the same on Computer.

Computer Test Computer Proficiency Test Qualify Computer Proficiency Test (work Processing and Spread Sheets). Marks of proficiency test would not be counted towards the final merit as it is only qualifying in nature.
The selection process comprises a Shorthand Test and Computer Proficiency Test
Select list will be prepared on the basis of merit.
how_to_apply: Visit the official Sessions Division, Jind website to download the prescribed format of the application form.

Take a printout of the application form and fill in all mandatory fields including name, father's/husband's name, date of birth, age as on 01.07.2026, gender, category, nationality, permanent address, correspondence address, academic qualifications, experience, and contact number/e-mail ID.
Affix a latest passport-size coloured photograph on the designated space of the application form.
Attach copies of requisite certificates along with two self-addressed properly stamped envelopes.

Send the original application with enclosures to the office of the Superintendent of Sessions Division, Jind, either by registered post or by hand, well before the closing date i.e. 30.10.2026 by 05:00 P.M.
Mention on the top of the envelope: "Application for the post of Stenographer Grade III (Adhoc basis)".

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the Stenographer Grade-III recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Office of the District and Sessions Judge, Jind.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Stenographer Grade-III?
faq.answer: There are a total of 12 vacancies available for the Stenographer Grade-III post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form is 30.10.2026 up to 5:00 P.M.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Graduation degree in any stream or equivalent from a recognized university, have proficiency in computer operations (word processing and spreadsheets), and have passed matriculation with Hindi or English as a subject.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 42 years of age as on 01.07.2026, with upper age relaxation applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for Jind District Court Stenographer Grade-III?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated pay of Rs. 25,500/- (initial pay in FPL-4) or at such revised rate as prescribed by the Government of Haryana.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their applications in the prescribed format offline either by hand or by registered post to the office of the Superintendent of Sessions Division, Jind.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection involves a Shorthand Test (80 W.P.M. English Shorthand and 20 W.P.M. transcription) and a qualifying Computer Proficiency Test, followed by a merit list.

faq.question: Q10. When will the shorthand test be conducted?
faq.answer: The date, time, and place of the Shorthand Test/Computer Proficiency Test will be uploaded on the official website of Sessions Division, Jind.
